reviews.text: C4 Renovations has done a truly amazing job transforming my home. Last year, he repainted the inside of my home after a flood. He was professional, knowledgeable and had great customer service and fair pricing. This year, I needed to have the outside of the house painted, so I called on Chris again. He came through!!! He painted the entire house in 4 days, communicated throughout the process and did an amazing job. I'll continue to use C4 Renovations and Chris for all my home projects. Highly recommend!!

Great experience. Chris was amazing to work with. He was insightful on how colors would look in different areas based on lighting and location. He was also receptive to our suggestions and patient with our changes. He produced a great product in the timeline he originally identified. Definitely plan to work with him again.

Chris and his team did a wonderful job painting our basement. It looks like a brand new area, and we can’t wait until they make the rest of our 20+ year old home look brand new as well! Pricing was fair and payment options were provided. We look forward to the next project! Highly recommended!

facts.about_text: We are a contractor working out of Buford, GA and surrounding communities. We are a top rated construction service provider, and from the first nail to the final creative touches our contractor and crew will turn your home into a modern, unique, and comfortable place to live. We proudly offer home renovation, interior painting and exterior painting.
